rationale: Motor vehicle collision causing severe damage to the policyholder's car and bodily injury to the policyholder; this is an auto claim.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended on Route 9 by an unbraked vehicle at 8:15 am yesterday; the car is totaled with the trunk crushed into the back seat. The claimant sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. This is a high-severity auto collision with injuries; the other driver's insurance information is available on the police report.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle traveling ~35 mph, other driver did not brake
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat

rationale: Tree fell on the policyholder's parked vehicle causing hood and windshield damage; this is comprehensive auto coverage (natural event damaging the insured vehicle).
claim_summary: Maple tree from policyholder's own yard blown down by wind and landed on parked vehicle in driveway, causing hood and windshield damage. Estimated repair cost $3,000–$8,000; comprehensive auto claim with $1,000 deductible under active policy POL-1005.

case_facts.description: maple tree from own yard blown down by wind, hit parked car
